capabilities: create notes via a command in the current folder
extras: README states the plugin is in early alpha and lists unfinished TODOs, such as warning when a parent note does not exist.
problem: Obsidian notes have no built-in way to define or traverse a parent-child hierarchy based on note names.

relations.evidence: build hierarchy in notes using . (like in dendron)

summary: Hierarchical note management plugin that uses dot-notation note names (e.g. aws.ec2.security-groups) to create, navigate and rename parent-child notes.
